entities.summary: Jeremy Miles Tyler is an American professional basketball player who last played for the Al-Arabi of the Qatari Basketball League. Tyler was drafted with the 39th pick in the 2011 NBA draft by the Charlotte Bobcats but immediately traded to the Golden State Warriors.
